title: host status test seeds a live claim with a fake process start time ("T0") but the host reads with the real probe: the test fails wherever the OS reports a start time, and it masks the tenant check
evidence: scripts/webinar/send-now-host.test.ts:181-183: claimLiveRecording(..., aliveProbe) stores processStartedAt="T0"; createSendNowDeps status calls readSessionStatus(...) with default probes, getProcessStartTime(pid) returns a real ISO time here, controllerMatchesIdentity -> proven PID reuse -> not live -> status "launching" not "running". Reproduced 15/15 runs of send-now-host.test.ts on the checker machine (13x fail 1, 2x fail 2). Because that test aborts at line 183, its tenant-not-served assertion (line 186-187) never runs: mutation `tenantId !== tenant` -> `&& false` in send-now-host.ts status() SURVIVES (only the same pre-existing failure + timing test fail).
reproduction: cd <lane>; node --test --import tsx scripts/webinar/send-now-host.test.ts -> fail 1: status: live claim by that job id = running ... expected running, actual launching.
fix_direction: Let SendNowHostOptions accept a test-only LiveProbes (or seed the claim with the real start time: omit probes.startTime), and split the foreign-tenant assertion into its own test that does not depend on the running case. Re-measure by mutating the host tenant check: it must be killed.
